resolved_finding.description: Rank-pulse overlap corrected by color-only Indicate, confirmed by exact PNG matches to the previously inspected focused repair clips and every decoded pulse-window frame.

limitations: Every source frame decoded/analyzed at 320px width; every source frame was not visually inspected.
Selected source times have at most 1 second gaps, subject to source timestamp quantization and floating-point precision. Changes between selected times may remain unseen.
RGB adjacent-frame thresholds can miss small, slow or subtle changes; unconditional bounded-gap selection supplements them.
Native PNG content was inspected using chronological 640px-wide contact-sheet tiles; selected priority native frames were viewed separately. Not all images were viewed separately at native scale.
Continuous perceptual playback, narration listening/alignment, production-resolution/mobile/player behavior remain unverified.
Unchanged source pixels inherit prior actual review only when exact PNG SHA256 matches. This does not transfer audio, pacing, or continuous playback coverage.
